# Adopt v1.4.1

This compatible patch restores the Reference's intended blank Graphite favicon. It does not change theme roles, accent palettes, surface tones, typography, geometry, runtime requirements or public commands. If upgrading from before v1.4.0, also follow [the v1.4.0 migration](v1.4.0.md).

## Pin and rebuild

After the v1.4.1 tag is public, update the immutable dependency, lockfile and consumer manifest together. Use the exact 1.4.1 Swift Package Manager version where applicable. Rebuild and deploy the complete portable Reference artifact on every host. See [the release process](../releases.md) for publication verification.

Both the root-hosted mirror and canonical subpath build now select `assets/app-icon-monochrome-base.svg` as their SVG favicon. The PNG fallback at `assets/favicon-32.png` is generated from the same blank Graphite base. Their URL revision changes to `graphite-blank-1` to refresh cached browser-tab artwork.

The separate checkmark example SVGs and platform-icon exports remain available for illustrating product glyph construction. Products retain their own identifying glyphs. This correction affects the Reference tab identity, not the shared icon recipe.
